description: Na₇NbO₆ crystallizes in the trigonal R3 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.41 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.40 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.44 Å) and three longer (2.77 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Nb is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.04 Å) and three longer (2.11 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Nb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Nb atom.
